title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat: create and query Planner tasks and plans
summary: The rollout, licensing and neighbouring controls are supported, with no blocking findings. Add the beta API warning and the Facilitator side effect to the pilot advice; the membership checklist also lacks a corresponding control row.

claims.claim: The briefing calls the products Microsoft 365 Copilot and Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Copilot is now named Microsoft Copilot, and Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat is now named Microsoft Copilot Chat.
claims.fix: Use 'Microsoft Copilot' and 'Microsoft Copilot Chat' in the briefing's own product references; preserve attributed roadmap and Message Center titles and quotations.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: A switch specific to this Copilot Chat Planner capability is not documented as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner Copilot Chat disable admin AllowPlannerCopilot; Planner Copilot Chat Graph admin block. Opened Planner Plugin Cowork, turn-off-planner-agent, package block and overview; results describe neighbouring controls, not this capability.

claims.claim: The identity Chat uses to call Planner is not described for this capability.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner Copilot Chat approval identity permissions. Read MC1443523, Planner service description and Planner Plugin Cowork; Cowork documents its signed-in-user connector, but no returned passage specifies this Chat capability's calling identity.

claims.claim: Whether this Chat capability requests approval before writing a change is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner Copilot Chat approval identity permissions. Read MC1443523, Planner service description, Planner Plugin Cowork and search excerpts on Cowork approvals; approval passages concern Cowork, not this Chat capability.

claims.claim: Microsoft's notice names no separate data boundary for this feature.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner Copilot Chat approval identity permissions; read MC1443523 in full. It states existing Planner permissions and access controls continue to apply and names no additional data boundary.

claims.claim: A meter specific to this Copilot Chat Planner capability is not yet published.

claims.claim: The Cowork Planner Plugin can be blocked at Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > Tools > Planner Plugin > Users > Block.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block blocks a Copilot package.
claims.quote:
Block a Copilot package to prevent its usage.
POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block
APIs under the /beta version are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.
claims.fix: Keep the call and add to controls[0].note and its rendered row: 'The block operation is preview; beta APIs are subject to change and their use in production applications is not supported.'

claims.claim: Get-PlannerConfiguration retrieves the current settings for the documented Planner restrictions.
claims.quote:
To verify your settings, run the following command:
Get-PlannerConfiguration

claims.claim: Setting AllowPlannerCopilot to false turns off the documented Planner Agent experiences and can be tested in a pilot.
claims.quote:
Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $false
Turning off Planner Agent will also disable document authoring skill of Facilitator. All other Facilitator skills remain unaffected.
claims.fix: Add to the pilot bullet: 'Turning off Planner Agent also disables Facilitator's document authoring skill; all other Facilitator skills remain unaffected.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/planner/turn-off-planner-agent.
